basis: Authored safeguard assessment criteria; CIS v8.1 requirements, not CAS metrics. Evidence examples and optional context do not impose additional obligations.

17.5.title: Assign Key Roles and Responsibilities
17.5.guidance: Record who fulfils each relevant incident-response function, including providers where applicable. One person or team may fulfil multiple functions; separate departments are not required.
evidence: Role roster and contact/escalation record. Use representative records covering the stated population.
Existing Reviews, Findings and Actions can trace exceptions and validation; combined records may support multiple safeguards.

elements.text: Key incident-response roles and responsibilities are assigned.
Assignments are reviewed annually and when significant changes could affect the safeguard.
Where relevant, third parties have assigned incident-response roles and responsibilities.
